propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches destination STATUS names against transition names instead of transition destination statuses, causing lookup failures on workflows where transition names differ from status names
outbound status changes fail silently: ValueError is caught and soft-failed into bridge_alerts, allowing the pass to exit 0 without applying the requested status change

some status transitions succeed (when transition name equals status name) while others fail unexpectedly, creating the appearance of a flaky or partial bridge rather than revealing a systematic mapping defect

the fix resolves a requested name first by exact transition-name match, then by unique to.name (destination status), raising on ambiguity or if unresolvable, and reports both transition names and their destinations in error messages
